__broaden__.αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the others’ (αἱ ἄλλαι ’the other ships’) · also fem. nom. pl., correlative, of the doors: αἱ μὲν … αἱ δ’ ’the one … the other’ · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the swine (αἱ δὲ νέμονται ’and they graze’)
__broaden__.αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject herself: ’(you) yourself’ · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (αὐτή μιν πόμπευον ’I myself escorted him’)
__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’
__broaden__.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’)
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a negative statement with a relative clause: οὐδὲ γένηται ’nor ever shall there be’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause without ἄν/κε: ’whatever shall come to pass’ (ὅσσα γένηται) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it become’ (μή … ἕλωρ … γένηται ’lest it become prey’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in an indirect clause after ὅπως: ’(consider) how it may turn out’ (ὅπως ὄχ’ ἄριστα γένηται)
__broaden__.γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’, θείοιο/τοῖο γέροντος ’of the divine/that old man’, epithets of Proteus) · also of an ordinary old man, with παλαιοῦ: ’of an aged old man’ · also ἁλίοιο γέροντος of Phorcys, the same epithet ’of the old man of the sea’
__broaden__.δόμοις: δόμος — house; masc. dat. pl.: ’in houses’ (ἐν postponed, with anastrophe) · also plural for a single house, after ἐν: ἐν Ἀτρεΐδαο δόμοις ’in the house of Atreus’ son’
__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’)

__broaden__.κατηρεφές: κατηρεφής — roofed over, covering from above, of a wave curling over; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., of a cave: σπέος … κατηρεφές ’a roofed-over, vaulted cave’
__broaden__.μαχοίμην: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. opt. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that I might fight’ · also pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would fight’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην)
__broaden__.μενοεικέα: μενοεικής — satisfying, to one’s heart’s desire (μένος + ἔοικα); neut. acc. pl. · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with βάλανον: ’satisfying (acorn)’
__broaden__.νηϊάδες: νηϊάς — Naiad, water-nymph; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ναϊάδες) · also fem. voc. pl.: νύμφαι νηϊάδες ’Naiad nymphs!’
__broaden__.νύμφαι: νύμφη — nymph; also bride; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address: ’nymphs!’
__broaden__.κοῦραι: κούρη — girl, daughter (Attic κόρη); fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address: κοῦραι Διός ’daughters of Zeus!’
__broaden__.παῖδά: παῖς — child, son, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’ · also masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’son’ (παῖδά τε σὸν ’and your son’)
__broaden__.περικαλλέ: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέα) · also neut. acc./nom. dual, elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέε), with ὄσσε: ’the two very fair (eyes)’
__broaden__.πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. __broaden__.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. __broaden__.τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with νόημα: ’such (a thought)’
__broaden__.τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, foster; pres. 3 sg. (of Amphitrite fostering sea-creatures) · also of food, ’nourishes, makes thrive’ (τά θ’ ὕεσσι τρέφει τεθαλυῖαν ἀλοιφήν ’which nourishes thriving fat on pigs’)
__broaden__.ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’unseemly things’ (ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων ’pondering unseemly things’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly, shabby (wallet)’
__broaden__.ἀλόχου: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. gen. sg., with πρός · also fem. gen. sg. as object of πειράω (+ gen.): ’of your wife’ (σῆς ἀλόχου πειρήσεαι ’you will make trial of your wife’)
__broaden__.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ (ἀ- + root of ἔννεπε ’tell’) · also agreeing with οὖδας: ἄσπετον οὖδας ’the vast ground’
__broaden__.ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; here as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἐπί ... ἤλυθεν = ἐπῆλθεν ’came on, came upon’); accented ἐπί before the following enclitic τε · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ἐπί τε κρήνῃ Ἀρεθούσῃ ’and at the spring Arethusa’)
__broaden__.ἠεροειδές: ἠεροειδής — misty, murky, dim (ἀήρ ’mist’ + εἶδος); adj., neut. nom. sg. (with σπέος) · also neut. acc. sg. (with σπέος, object of δῦνε)
__broaden__.ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg., object of ἷξε: ‘the mountain’ · also neut. nom. sg., ’a mountain’, subject of a verbless clause naming it: ἐν δ’ ὄρος αὐτῇ ’and on it a mountain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with ἐστιν: ’(this) is the mountain’ (Νήριτόν ἐστιν ὄρος)
__broaden__.κευθμῶνας: κευθμών — hiding-place, den, pen; masc. acc. pl.: ’pens, sties’ · also ’hiding-places, recesses’ of a cave (μαιομένη κευθμῶνας ἀνὰ σπέος ’searching out the recesses’)
